summary: AP tank who pokes with barrels, dashes in with a stun, and knocks you away with his ult. He trades in short bursts and disengages. Bait his E, stay out of barrel range, and he has little left.
threats: Q (Barrel Roll) is his main poke; it grows stronger the longer it sits before exploding.
E (Body Slam) dashes and stuns. It's both his engage and his escape.
W (Drunken Rage) reduces the damage he takes and empowers his next auto.
R (Explosive Cask) at 5 knocks you away. It can knock you into his jungler or out of a fight.

matchups.why: Riposte parries Gragas's E stun or R knockback and turns it back on him, and vitals deal true damage through his W damage reduction. Fiora has the dashes to dodge his barrels.
trading: Hold W (Riposte) for his E Body Slam; parry it and stun him back.
Lunge (Q) sideways out of his barrel before it explodes.
Trade on vitals when his E is on cooldown; he can't escape.
Save W for his R if his E has already been used.
matchups.early: Trade on vitals once his E is down; he can't disengage without it.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R can knock you away; keep W ready for it in extended fights.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and fight in his cooldown windows.
matchups.jungle: He escapes with E. Gank once he's used it.
matchups.build: Conqueror. MR boots against his AP poke.

matchups.why: Olaf's R (Ragnarok) makes him immune to Gragas's stun and knockback, and E (Reckless Swing) true damage ignores Gragas's W damage reduction. Olaf wins every all-in once he can run through Gragas's CC.
trading: Q (Undertow) him to slow his escape, then pick up the axe and stay on him.
Use E (Reckless Swing) for true damage through his W.
At 5, activate R before he E's or R's you so his CC doesn't land.
Sidestep his barrel before it explodes.
matchups.early: Bully him at levels 1–3 with Q and E; he can't stop your all-in early.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R ignores his CC. Use it to stick to him through his R knockback.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and all-in when his E is down.
matchups.jungle: He escapes with E. Gank once he's used it.

matchups.why: Gragas's damage is magic, so Malphite's armor doesn't help, but Malphite's Q poke and R give him kill pressure with a jungler. Neither can kill the other alone.
trading: Q (Seismic Shard) him when he walks up to farm.
Sidestep his barrel before it explodes.
Don't trade long; he disengages with E.
Buy MR early; armor won't help here.
matchups.early: Farm and Q poke. Neither of you can kill the other alone, so don't waste HP.
matchups.spike: At 5 your R plus your jungler kills him; his R can knock you away from your engage.
matchups.wave: Slow-push and roam once your R is up; he can't stop the wave fast.
matchups.jungle: Your R sets up ganks. Call when his E is down.
matchups.build: Grasp. MR boots and early MR items.

matchups.why: Gragas pokes Darius with barrels and disengages with E and R before Darius can stack Hemorrhage. Darius has to land E pull to win any trade, and Gragas rarely stays in range.
trading: Sidestep his barrel before it explodes.
E (Apprehend) pull him only when he's used his E.
Stack Hemorrhage quickly once you've pulled him; he'll try to disengage.
Don't chase him through his R knockback.
matchups.early: Farm safely and accept some poke; wait for him to waste E before you walk up.
matchups.spike: At 5 his R knocks you out of fights; your R execute needs him in range.
matchups.wave: Let him push and farm under tower, where his barrel poke is less safe for him.
matchups.jungle: Ask for ganks once his E is down; he has no escape.
matchups.build: Conqueror. Ghost for chasing. MR boots.
matchups.remember: Wait for his E, then pull.
